title: Kestrel and the Vow
author: Marguerite Quintana
blurb: August Underhill, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
